method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill (and references/regulative.md), from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18 and the rulings on negatives of 2026-11-04 and 2026-11-05 (the text's no where it says no; a NOTHING-kind tag or NOTHING where it does not answer); the dates in one module, the rules and exported questions in another, the cases in a third; three regulative rules (s 46PH(1)(b) lodge within 24 months; s 46PI(2) with s 46PM give information within the period the notice specifies; s 46PO(2) apply to the court within 60 days of the termination notice) run by EVALTRACE inside exported questions that take only plain facts; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Australian Human Rights Commission Act 1986, Compilation No. 58, compilation date 18 September 2026 (includes amendments up to Act No. 87, 2026; register id C2026C00416), with s 46PSA as substituted by the Australian Human Rights Commission Amendment (Costs Protection) Act 2024 (No. 89, 2024), as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/C2004A03366.txt

seat: the person aggrieved by alleged unlawful discrimination, who complains to the Australian Human Rights Commission and, if the President terminates the complaint, may apply to the Federal Court or the Federal Circuit and Family Court of Australia (Division 2); also that person as a class member of a representative complaint or a person on whose behalf a representative application is made (ahrc-complaints.l4)

checks.l4: stable l4 of VS Code extension legalese.l4-vscode 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset
checks.command: l4 run ahrc-dates.l4 ; l4 run ahrc-complaints.l4 ; l4 run ahrc-cases.l4
checks.result: 170 assertions written, 170 satisfied, 0 errors, 0 warnings in every file (2026-11-07)
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read. Expected values worked by hand from the text. One expectation changed in a scratch copy was reported as failing.

scope: Part IIB (redress for unlawful discrimination), from the complainant's seat. In: s 3(1) (affected person, class member, complainant, representative application, representative complaint, respondent, unlawful discrimination); ss 46P, 46PA, 46PB, 46PC(1), 46PD, 46PE(1)-(3), 46PF(1), (1B), (3)-(5), (7), (8), (10), (11), 46PG, 46PH, 46PI(2), 46PJ(3)-(7), 46PK(2), (4)-(7), 46PKA, 46PM(1), (1A), (3), 46PN, 46PO, 46POA, 46POB(1)-(3), 46PP, 46PQ, 46PSA (the 2024 costs protection rule), 46PT, 46PU. Out: Parts I, II (other than s 3(1)), IIA, IIC, III and the rest; the Part II Division 3 and 4 inquiries into human rights and equal opportunity in employment (they end in a report, not a remedy); the President's internal procedure; ss 46PR, 46PS, 46PV, 46PZ. Reasons in NOTES.md.
